thread:
liz: Quick poll — late-afternoon donut truce? Also: microwave etiquette reminder pls. Coffee is running low :coffee:
omar: I can swing by a donut place at 3:30. maple vs glazed?
jessa: Donuts sound great but can we do bagels this time? less sticky keyboards.
kyle: Microwave etiquette rule #1: cover your food or lose it to the communal purge :face_with_thermometer:  
michelle: FYI there's an extra unopened can of beans on the top shelf. don't grind the last bag unless you're committing to restocking.
liz: @michelle omg thank you. Also, can whoever nuked fish on Thursday apologize to the breakroom plants :pray:
omar: Maple for the win. I'll grab 2 dozen and a small oat milk jug. Leaving a note for who takes the last donut?
jessa: Could we put a Post-it: "Take 1, leave a note" — very scientific.
kyle: Also can we set a 10-min microwave timer rule? If it's over, poke the owner or move it to labeled shelf.
michelle: Agreed on a timer. And small request — let's stop reheating salmon. It's hostile to shared airspace.
kitchen-bot: Automated notice: Coffee inventory low — ground coffee 1 bag remaining, K-cups 8. Suggested action: restock within 48h. react :bell:
liz: Thanks @kitchen-bot. Omar, if you can add a couple bags of ground to your run that'd be perfect.
omar: Yep adding a bag. Also leaving a little note with bagels/donuts so people don't second-guess.
jessa: I'll make a tiny sign template: "Take one. Leave a note." and stick to the shelf.
kyle: Whoever invented microwaves for office use is a hero and a villain. Carrying marshmallows in my heart.
michelle: Tiny sign and donut truce = peaceful Friday. See you at 3:30. :raised_hands:
